$comment: The reels' asset map: public/site/<name> ← the media or brand ID it is cut from (ADR 0069 §2). video/scripts/sync-assets.mjs copies the record's first rendition in the name's format that is not a sized cut (card.jpg, <name>-<width>.*) (content/media.json renditions, brand/assets.json served); scripts/check-content.mjs checks every ID exists. Add a line here, never drop a file into public/site/ by hand.
